# TASK

> Every page of the TASK module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Reprocess, cancel and shortfall](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-86/docs/nhcx/v1/api/task): The reprocess, cancel and shortfall calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Payer: send the task outcome](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-86/docs/nhcx/v1/api/task/endpoints/task-v1-task-on-submit): Payer returns a Task bundle with Task.status completed whose Task.output references a ClaimResponse carrying the reprocess or cancellation outcome.
- [Provider: submit a reprocess or cancel task](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-86/docs/nhcx/v1/api/task/endpoints/task-v1-task-submit): Provider sends an FHIR Task asking the payer to reprocess a rejected or short-paid claim or to cancel a preauth; Task.code and reasonCode set the intent.
- [Provider receives the task outcome](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-86/docs/nhcx/v1/api/task/endpoints/task-webhook-v1-task-on-submit): Hosted by the provider. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/task/on_submit, with the headers and the sealed payload...
- [Payer receives a reprocess or cancel task](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-86/docs/nhcx/v1/api/task/endpoints/task-webhook-v1-task-submit): Hosted by the payer. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/task/submit, with the headers and the sealed payload the...
- [Reprocess, cancel and shortfall errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-86/docs/nhcx/v1/api/task/errors): What Reprocess, cancel and shortfall returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
